Name: Event Indicators
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod adds exclamation mark indicators to warp points and doors to show that there is a cutscene event that will play if you enter that location.

Hovering over the indicator lets you know the ID or name of the event to be played.

If you hold down a mod key (default [b]left shift[/b]) while hovering, it will show the entire event string if available.
